result.keyword: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Gold Coast? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

items.markdown:
Top luxury real estate agencies on the Gold Coast include [Kollosche](https://kollosche.com.au/), [Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/) , and Astras Prestige Property . These firms dominate high-end waterfront, beachfront, and acreage markets through large database networks, high-value record sales, and boutique localized service.

### Shortlist of Prestige Agencies

- [Kollosche](https://kollosche.com.au/) - Market leader in high-end residential and commercial coastal properties spanning from Sovereign Islands down to Byron Bay. Known for an open database model that drives team collaboration and strong results across prime postcodes like Mermaid Beach and Broadbeach.[[1]](https://kollosche.com.au/)
- [Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/) - Renowned for record-breaking multi-million dollar transactions along Hedges Avenue and Isle of Capri. Backed by an extensive network of over 250,000 high-net-worth individuals, celebrities, and qualified buyers.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)
- [Astras Prestige Property](https://astras.com.au/) - Established boutique agency specializing in premium waterfront and residential communities like Clear Island Waters and Broadbeach Waters. Focuses on targeted outcomes and personalized client strategy over high-volume sales.[[1]](https://astras.com.au/)
